title: Full-problem track: review, v4 re-run and merge of worktree-full-problem
description:
STATE.md ## Next row 5, with the track's PLAN.md (`git show worktree-full-problem:PLAN.md`, night checkpoint 2026-09-11, head 3e9d002, 801 tests pass).

Goal: extend the methodology, models and Streamlit app from one channel (national) to the full CWIFI problem: $48B across national, WH and FI on CONUS, each carved into contiguous districts of about $1B (floor $800MM, cap $1.2B), one wholesaler per district and at most one district per wholesaler, channels designed in priority order national, WH, FI, the residual called "other". The new decision is the channel structure per state (keep three, merge WH and FI, drop national). Delivered on the track: `docs/FULL_PROBLEM.md`, `docs/MODEL_FULL.md`, the level-0 plan solver, the per-bundle projection tool and the driver `tools/full_plan.py`.

The merge is gated on the stakeholder review (rank 1 frozen in `best/`, or a full-rules cell from `grid_20260911_full/` in its place) and on the v4 file, `instance_descaled_v4.json.gz`, which the user exports and the ranked cells are re-run on; then rebase onto main, fast-forward (ask first), record the facts in memories. The user decisions and queued items are the child beads.
design: Formulation (docs/FULL_PROBLEM.md, docs/MODEL_FULL.md). Cells (zip, channel) with fine labels N_WH, N_FI, WH, FI; national falls back into WH and FI by the zip's own WH:FI mass ratio. Bundles: N, WH, FI, WH+ = {WH, N_WH}, FI+ = {FI, N_FI}, WHFI, WHFI+ (off by default, ★B). A district is (zip set, bundle), connected in the proximity graph induced on the bundle's zips, band L = 0.8 tau to U = 1.2 tau, staffed by one rep; objective max Σ_j log g over reps (stage 2 as today). Decomposition: fix the channel plan and every bundle is today's single-channel problem on its projected instance; the only coupling across bundles is the rep constraint, one Hungarian. Level 0 plans at state x channel granularity with slots per bundle (y shares, z contacts, u slot used; cover, band, single-commodity flow, symmetry rows), solved as lexicographic passes (cover_N, cover_WH, cover_FI, contacts, compactness tie-break). Rules adopted 2026-09-11: split caps CA 3, TX 2, NY 3 with --band-break CA,TX; --sweep and --plus-pair at level 0; --sweep-zips and --split-cut contiguous (WH only) in the realiser; four legal state patterns. Known gap: level-2 cross-bundle overlap when two bundles share a channel in one state; today plan_realise awards the cell to the bundle with more file channels, and the proper fix is a two-stage cut by the level-0 shares.
